name: Makoto Miyamura
source: Student council president, Sensei's classroom assistant, and top student in her year. Makoto looks up to Sensei tremendously, wanting to be a teacher herself one day, and drinks in recognition and appreciation for her hard work. She can be found working at her family business at night.
